$comment: Assets this video uses. 'cc0' packs are downloaded by `npm run assets` into assets/cc0/ (git-ignored, licence kept next to each). 'textures' are CC0 PBR sets from Poly Haven into assets/textures/. 'roblox' items are fetched for local use only by `npm run roblox` into assets/roblox/ (git-ignored, never committed or published). The template's sample needs none of them: it is built in code.
